title: Capture of Malacca (1511)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Malacca (1511)", at revision 1373484620, opens: "The governor of Portuguese India Afonso de Albuquerque conquered the city of Malacca in 1511." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4110453, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1511 Portuguese military conquest". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
